subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: Should omitted-node `nodes` `describe` calls resolve through the existing default-node picker, return list-style discovery data, or remain invalid with a stricter model-facing schema?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but each fix changes the model-facing contract differently, especially for multi-node users.

options.title: Confirm default-node describe
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only default-node lookup and require the linked PR or replacement to add focused regression coverage and redacted proof.

options.title: Use list-style discovery
options.body: Replace the candidate PR with behavior that returns node-list discovery data when `node` is omitted, avoiding implicit target selection.

options.title: Require explicit node
options.body: Keep `describe` target-specific and update the model-facing schema or prompt contract so agents know `node` is required.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-node describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only default-node lookup and require the linked PR or replacement to add focused regression coverage and redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history on both the flattened nodes tool schema and shared default-node resolver involved in this contract choice.
